title: AutoinstallManifest
description: Stage 1 (planner) → Stage 2 (executor) contract. The planner writes this JSON to <workdir>/setup-manifest.json after exploring the repo; the executor must get target_commands passing. Sparse camelCase wire form (None optionals omitted), validated with the stdlib _validate_against_schema.

setupSteps.description: Ordered hints the executor MAY run to set up the env (install/script/env).

targetCommands.description: Commands that MUST run successfully once the env is set up. The verifier re-runs each.

expectedOutcome.description: Natural-language description of a correctly-set-up env.

mocks.description: Anticipated mocks (MinIO config, fake DB user, placeholder files).
